newsitem.title: SPAIN: SEPI to sell Elcano for 5.8 billion pesetas.
newsitem.headline: SEPI to sell Elcano for 5.8 billion pesetas.

text.p: Spanish state holding group Sociedad Estatal de Participaciones Industriales (SEPI) said on Tuesday it had approved the sale of cargo shipper Elcano to a group of companies for a total 5.77 billion pesetas.
The companies buying Elcano are Portugal's Soponata, Spain's Remolcanosa and Naviera Murueta, SEPI said.
The purchasers guarantee that the group will remain independent and ensure its workers will be kept.
The operation must be approved by the cabinet.

"SEPI had pre-selectioned two offers several months ago: the one presented by the group and the one by Ership, but it finally opted for the first given its commitment to a better price, solid financing and a more explicit industrial plan," SEPI said.
Elcano has the capacity to transport 1.4 million tonnes and has a staff of 42.
